description: Release responses the form's trust policy quarantined, so they enter the responses grid AND are delivered to every destination and webhook the form has — email, Sheets, Slack, whatever is wired up. That send cannot be recalled, so ASK THE HUMAN FIRST and pass confirm=true only once they agree. Read the held rows first with fillo_list_responses (held=true) so you can tell them what they are approving. Pass responseIds for specific rows or all=true for every held row on the form. Needs responses:manage.

all.description: Release every held response on this form.

confirm.description: Set true ONLY after the human has approved this action. Ask them first and quote what it will do — never set this on your own initiative.

form.description: Form id or hosted slug. A stable push handle also resolves on a login token; a project API key takes the id or slug.

name: fillo_release_responses
title: Release held responses
